modules.module_title: Prepare for carrying out milling operations

pcs.pc_description: plan the daily activities to achieve the given production targets
check the availability of the required tools and measuring instruments
check the measuring instruments to ensure they are within the calibration date
check the components before milling to ensure they are free from dirt, foreign objects and contamination
check the post-machining sheet to determine if the component meets the applicable quality standards from the previous machining operations
check the availability of relevant documents to determine the job specification, such as job card, engineering drawings, approved sketches/illustrations, etc.
determine the job requirements through coordination with the supervisor and going through the relevant documents
check the process sheet and match it with the received drawings and other specifications
prepare the work area for operations, following the applicable organisational procedure and operations requirements
coordinate with the machine setter to ensure the milling machine is ready for operations
check the machine guards are installed appropriately, and adjust them, as required
select the appropriate type of cutters according to the horizontal or vertical milling machine being used
clamp the workpiece securely and without distortion in a chuck/work holding device such as vice, V-block, clamp, angle plate, etc.
check for safe resting of the component on the resting pads and clamping load of fixture
operate the machine controls in hand or power modes, as required
adjust the machine settings as per the requirement to maintain the required accuracy and quality standards
identify abnormal noises coming from the machine and component, and adjust the feed and Revolutions Per Minute (RPM), as required
check the condition of the tools being used and repair them, as required
check the components are free from false tool cuts, burrs and sharp edges
follow the manufacturer’s instructions to stop and restart the milling machine during emergencies
carry out various milling operations to produce various features on metal and non-metal components
follow the recommended practices to overcome the effects of backlash in machine slides and screws
create roughing and finishing cuts to achieve the required surface finish and dimensional accuracy with minimum impact on tools
use cutting fluids for lubrication, and reducing friction on a variety of materials

use the relevant equipment such as tri- square, bevel protractor, Vernier calliper and micrometre to check critical parameters such as dimensions, squareness, hole size/fit, angles, flatness, surface finish, etc
remove the components from the milling machine after performing the necessary quality checks or carry out further milling, as appropriate
follow the manufacturer’s instructions while operating various types of milling machines, such as horizontal and vertical milling machines
ensure the milled components have the required dimensional tolerance, flatness and squareness; surface finish and angles
follow the relevant quality control procedures while operating the milling machine and other relevant equipment
use the relevant Industry 4.0 manufacturing technologies to ensure interconnectivity, automation, machine learning, and real-time data collection and analysis
coordinate with the relevant personnel to resolve any issues experienced while carrying out milling
record the measured values as per the organisational standards and complete the post- machining inspection sheet
isolate the milling machine appropriately after use
clean the milling machine and other relevant tools and equipment
collect and dispose of the industrial waste appropriately following the applicable environmental regulations and organisational procedures
comply with the applicable health, safety, environmental and other relevant regulations
select and use the appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) during machining operations
follow the applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and instructions at work
follow the organisational policy to deal with any hazards encountered during operations
use the relevant power and manual tools, equipment, and accessories as per the manufacturer's instructions to avoid injury and achieve work efficiency
optimise the usage of electricity and other resources in various tasks and processes
connect the electrical tools and equipment safely, and turn them off when not in use
